description: Send a draft made with create_draft, with its attachments, immediately. fmsg messages are immutable: once sent they cannot be edited or recalled. Send within the user's requested task or authorized automation. If the host refuses it, its reason is returned verbatim and the message stays a draft.
name: send_draft

attachments.description: sorted by filename, the same order in every tool

type.description: media type; inferred from the filename when the host records none

hint.description: for you, not the user: a better way to do this next time

redacted.description: the kinds of secret replaced, such as github_token; empty when none

redactions.description: secrets replaced with placeholders before sending

resolved.description: short names and how they resolved, when any were given; confirm with the user if an address looks wrong

thread_topic.description: the thread's topic: the topic sent for a new message; for a reply, the thread root's topic, or null when the root is not visible

warnings.description: things to tell the user, such as redacted secrets or resolved short names

title: Send fmsg draft
